publication: Generated initially for local review; subsequently approved and published. See publication.json.
design:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: LOCAL DESIGN REVIEW SPRITE SHEET for Taser/WeldPoint, redesigning ONLY the standard crate and pressure plate.
Input images: image 1 is the CURRENT CRATE art/style reference, image 2 is CURRENT PRESSURE SWITCH art/style reference, image 3 is the actual GAME CAMERA and style reference. They are references, NOT layouts to copy.
Primary request: fix the confusing silhouettes. The crate must unmistakably be a solid freestanding BOX, and the pressure plate must unmistakably be a low FLOOR MECHANISM that the box goes ON TOP OF. Match the approved refined modern pixel art, muted palette, crisp hard edges, restrained detail, orthogonal top-down game grid with visible front heights. NO isometric rotation, no diamond grid, no perspective vanishing point. All objects face the exact same direction; horizontal edges horizontal, vertical edges vertical.
Create ONE transparent square 1536x1536 atlas, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, 512x512 cells. Equal empty margins, no dividers or cell backgrounds, NO text/letters/numbers/captions.
Rows are PALETTE variants of the SAME DESIGN: top neutral light gray (#bdc3c7 highlights, #7c858c body, #454d54 shadow), middle P1 muted burgundy/rose (#815751 and deeper wine shadows), bottom P2 muted teal (#65a090 and deep green shadows). Do not add navy clothing colors to these objects.
Columns: (1) a freestanding crate alone, (2) an unoccupied pressure plate, inactive/up, (3) that EXACT SAME CRATE resting ON TOP of that EXACT SAME plate, plate pressed/active.
Crate design: a real rigid cubical industrial SHIPPING CRATE. Show a square flat lid/top and a substantial deep vertical FRONT FACE, about 35% of total visible height, to communicate volume. Straight square corners. A clear X-shaped structural brace across the lid, two narrow binding rails, small corner fasteners, a horizontal lid seam, and a simple recessed lift slot on the front. The X should read as crate reinforcement, not a glowing UI icon. Limited clean pixel-cluster shading and tiny seams. NO rounded suitcase, NO desk drawer, NO flat button shape, NO gratuitous chamfer or beveled picture frame.
Pressure plate design: a BROAD, VERY LOW recessed pressure pad whose outer footprint is roughly 20% WIDER than the crate footprint, not a pedestal. Almost flush with the floor, with only a thin dark edge, a flat square weighted center bed, narrow perimeter gutter, four short inward-facing tick marks on the outer rim to suggest placement, and a tiny two-pixel-style status indicator inset at the lower edge. Visually entirely different from the crate. NO crate-like front face, NO carry handle, NO large raised square push-button, NO drawer-front. In column 2 its center is only very slightly lifted within the frame, indicator dark.
Loaded column 3: recreate column 1 crate with identical size, X brace, height and colors, clearly on TOP of column 2 plate. Show the plate's left, right and front rim exposed around the crate. Center bed depresses subtly, narrow perimeter indicators brighten in the ownership color (neutral off-white, P1 pale rose, P2 mint). Tight contact shadow immediately beneath crate emphasizes weight. No hovering or empty gap. The plate MUST remain clearly visible as a separate low surrounding shape. For all columns use the same ground anchor and scale, make the interaction intuitively legible even at 48-64 screen pixels.
Style invariants: fine modern pixel clusters, nearest-neighbor sharpness, no airbrush, no gradients/gloss, no ruins/weathering, no fantasy runes, no bloom halos, no cartoon chunky outlines. Real alpha transparent background, with NO black/white/checkerboard image background. Produce only the nine isolated sprites.
